# steadycron_agent_monitor (Data Source)

Fetches a SteadyCron AI agent monitor by its server-assigned `id`, including its outcome rules.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "steadycron_agent_monitor" "triage" {
  id = "01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef"
}

# A run is an ordered pair: /start when it begins, then the JSON report on completion.
output "start_ping_url" {
  value     = data.steadycron_agent_monitor.triage.start_ping_url
  sensitive = true
}

output "ping_url" {
  value     = data.steadycron_agent_monitor.triage.ping_url
  sensitive = true
}

# What this monitor treats as a unit of work — the noun itemsProduced is counted in.
output "items_label" {
  value = data.steadycron_agent_monitor.triage.items_label
}

output "monthly_budget_usd" {
  value = data.steadycron_agent_monitor.triage.rule_max_cost_usd_per_period
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `cron_expression` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `fail_ping_url` (String, Sensitive) URL to POST a failure report to.
- `grace_seconds` (Number) How long after the scheduled time the run may still `/start`.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `interval_seconds` (Number)
- `items_label` (String) What this agent produces, e.g. `tickets`.
- `key` (String) Stable job key used by SDKs and the MCP server.
- `max_run_duration_seconds` (Number) How long a started run may take before it counts as abandoned.
- `misfire_policy` (String) Misfire policy: `do_nothing` or `fire_once_now`.
- `name` (String)
- `ping_url` (String, Sensitive) Completion URL to POST the run report to.
- `report_required` (Boolean) Whether a success ping with no run report is recorded as unverified.
- `rule_cost_period` (String) `day` or `month` — the window the per-period ceiling sums over.
- `rule_empty_result_enabled` (Boolean) Whether a run reporting zero items produced is a failure.
- `rule_max_cost_usd_per_period` (Number) Per-period spend ceiling in USD; null when no ceiling is set.
- `rule_max_cost_usd_per_run` (Number) Per-run spend ceiling in USD; null when no ceiling is set.
- `rule_max_duration_ms` (Number)
- `rule_max_steps` (Number)
- `rule_max_tool_calls` (Number)
- `runbook_notes` (String)
- `runbook_url` (String)
- `start_ping_url` (String, Sensitive) URL to ping when a run begins.
- `status` (String)
- `tags` (Set of String)
- `timezone` (String)
- `token` (String, Sensitive)
- `updated_at` (String)
